Saïda : Le ministre de la Poste annonce: Saïda: The Minister of Posts announces an increase in internet speed at no extra cost and social advances for postal workers
En visite de travail et d'inspection dan: During a working and inspection visit to the wilaya of Saïda, the Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Mr. Sid Ali Zerrouki, unveiled a series of flagship measures aimed at boosting digital connectivity in Algeria while improving the socio-professional conditions of workers in the sector.
Une révolution de la vitesse : Plus de m: A speed revolution: More megabits for the same price
La grande annonce qui réjouira les inter: The major announcement that will delight internet users concerns the automatic increase in fixed internet speed capacities. The minister specified that this technical upgrade will be implemented without any additional financial charge for subscribers.
Concrètement, les clients bénéficiant ac: Specifically, customers currently benefiting from ADSL technologies with 10 and 15 Mbps offers will see their speed automatically switch to 20 Mbps. As for fiber optic (FTTH) subscribers, the jump is even more significant: the speed will increase from 60 Mbps to 100 Mbps. "This operation will come into effect tomorrow," the minister emphasized, reaffirming the State's commitment to democratizing access to high and very high-speed broadband.
Généralisation de l'optique et extension: Generalization of optics and extension of coverage
Au-delà de l'augmentation des vitesses,: Beyond the increase in speeds, Mr. Sid Ali Zerrouki insisted on the national strategy to generalize fiber optics across the national territory. The objective is to progressively replace old copper networks with FTTH technology, which is more stable and efficient.
Le ministre a également évoqué l'extensi: The minister also mentioned the extension of network coverage to reach remote areas of the wilaya of Saïda and the country, in order to reduce the digital divide and support the digital transformation of public and economic services.

Le secteur postal n'est pas en reste. Pr: The postal sector is not left behind. Taking advantage of his meeting with local executives and employees, the minister announced the launch of a major project: the revision of the collective agreement for Algérie Poste workers.
Cette mesure vise à moderniser le cadre: This measure aims to modernize the working framework, value the efforts of employees, and meet their socio-professional expectations. According to the press release, this revision is essential to guarantee the stability of the sector and improve the quality of service provided to citizens in post offices.
